title: CheckerHookPayload
description: JSON body of POST /hook/checker, sent only by the trusted workflow_run job of the proofs repo. Signing: the raw body bytes are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using HOOK_HMAC_SECRET over the string <timestamp>.<nonce>.<raw body>, sent as header X-Hook-Signature: sha256=<64 lowercase hex>. X-Hook-Timestamp is unix seconds and must be within 300 s of the desk clock. X-Hook-Nonce is 16 to 64 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-], stored in hook_nonce, and a repeat is refused with 409 conflict. See checker-headers.schema.json and hookSigningInput() in @massgap/schemas. lemma_id is the id of the file that was checked; for a refutation it is the negated twin's id and intake marks the original refuted. reason is null only for ACCEPTED.
